purpose: Capability routing for the ghostship-shopping orchestrator. Each retailer lists the categories it plausibly serves, whether it has local stores and/or delivers to Hawaii, and which provider serves each capability. Authorization lives in config/retailer-authorization.json; technical health is observed at runtime (ghostship-shopping doctor). This file does not claim either.

localities._note: Approximate town centroids, used only to rank practical nearby stores when a provider gives an address but no distance.

provider_types.printing_press: A checked-in Printing Press client's normalized commands.
provider_types.official_api: A documented public API (for example eBay Browse).
provider_types.browser: A deterministic CloakBrowser Playwright recipe in ghostship_shopping.providers.browser.
provider_types.blocked_reference: Research evidence only; never called by the orchestrator.
provider_types.context: The site's own selected store/ZIP in the browser profile; not a store locator, so nearby-store sweeps use that one store.

safeway.membership: Safeway club card (free) for club prices

gaps: Search, category, item, and store discovery read the first-party storefront gateway. It serves one pickup store (the owner's local area), so results are store-scoped.
local_inventory and pickup are not served: the gateway reports store-scoped availability but no per-store quantity, and foodland has no browser route.

walmart.membership: walmart-pp-cli uses no account; operator memberships in the Assistant profile apply only to browser checks that show them.

browser_qualification.detail: walmart.com search showed a 'Robot or human?' hold-button challenge in an ordinary browser session; not used.

gaps: Walmart's app fulfillment read states delivery availability and the destination-scoped item price, but no shipping charge, so delivered offers are leads with no delivered subtotal.

costco.membership: Costco membership needed to buy; warehouse prices are read without a login.
gaps: Costco.com delivered search and pricing read the first-party GRS catalog gateway and display-price/inventory endpoints (public page identifiers, no account). 2-Day Delivery has a basket threshold that can add a fee, so a delivered total is not claimed.
notes: Keep costco-pp-cli: Costco is reachable only through its mobile app API, so this Printing Press client is the required provider (the owner, 2026-09-27). Do not replace it with a browser recipe.

samsclub.membership: Sam's Club membership required for most purchases

browser_qualification.detail: Site context already set to the owner's local area a postal code / Pearl City club.

notes: The app client's fulfillment command reports club-scoped pickup and shipping availability and quantity; search is not club-scoped, so stock is attributed only to the club the fulfillment response resolved.

The app operations intermittently answer a live read with a short interstitial; the client and provider retry a bounded number of times and fail closed. A sustained automated burst can extend that interstitial, so pace reads.

gaps: Target's CDUI and RedSky operations return HTTP 435 without the site's own session; the client replays the site's request with browser-acquired cookies.
notes: The client reads Target's CDUI operations with an ordinary visitor session acquired through the cookie bridge; it re-acquires automatically when the session is missing, expired, or challenged. The browser discovers the request shape and owns the session; the client makes the data request.

browser_qualification.detail: Site context: the owner's local area store, 96707.

gaps: The full product-detail (PIP) document is served through the app BFF GraphQL, which needs an app session; the client item_detail reads the store-scoped search card (price, stock, pickup/delivery eligibility).
Delivery charge and delivery dates are not exposed by the app search response, so no delivered total is computed; shipping_quote is not routed.
The app key is operator-supplied from Bitwarden (homedepot.com); inject it via agent run --bw homedepot.com:HOMEDEPOT.

lowes.requires_model_number: Lowe's keyword search is refused by the retailer (app API and website); Lowe's serves only exact model-number queries.

browser_qualification.detail: www.lowes.com /search answers Access Denied in the Default profile (direct URL and the site's own search box); the protected Assistant profile is not used for shopping.

gaps: Keyword and category search are refused by the retailer on every permitted path: the app's /fulcra/search/items answers HTTP 403 with or without a bearer, and www.lowes.com /search and /pl/<category> answer Access Denied in an ordinary browser. Lowe's therefore serves only queries that name a model number; other queries report Lowe's as disabled with this reason.

Local mode resolves the model, then reads each nearby store's on-hand quantity and store price from the app's nearby-store inventory (the owner's local area 0119 and the owner's local area-Honolulu 2336 for a postal code; there is no the owner's local area store).

Delivered mode states delivery eligibility for the ZIP from the item resolver; the app operations expose no shipping charge or date, so Lowe's offers stay leads and are never ranked as a delivered total.

browser_qualification.detail: Site context: the owner's local area store.

gaps: Store discovery is via the v7 stores endpoint; the app client currently scopes search by ZIP and storeId and does not expose a standalone store directory command.
Shipping charge is only as stated by the response ("FREE" -> 0); a calculated-at-checkout charge stays null.
The identifierForVendor and WebView User-Agent are synthetic runtime inputs, not a real device identity.

amazon.membership: None represented: the client reads the signed-out delivery promise. A conditional promise (for example free shipping over a threshold) leaves cost unknown.

client_status.amazon-pp-cli: active (destination delivery promise through the item page's own location control)

gaps: Search and item detail are store-less server-rendered pages, so price alone is not destination-scoped.
Destination delivery uses the item page's own location control: an unconditional stated cost is a quote, while a conditional promise (for example free shipping over a threshold) leaves cost unknown.
Amazon can challenge plain clients under load; the client fails closed as a challenge and does not bypass it.

dependencies: eBay developer keyset for the official Browse API (optional; the first-party web path needs none)
notes: Search and item detail read eBay's first-party server-rendered pages; shipping is US country-scoped, not a ZIP quote. The official Browse API is preferred when a keyset is provisioned.
gaps: Item-page shipping is country-scoped (USA), not destination-ZIP verified, so an eBay delivered subtotal is not claimed.

notes: Search and category read AliExpress's server-rendered /w/ pages and return product id, title, price, discount, rating, sold count, and a US country-level delivery window. Shipping is not destination-verified, so an AliExpress offer cannot be ranked as a delivered total; its candidates appear as leads.
gaps: Item-page shipping is not destination-verified: the item page is client-rendered (no product/shipping module) and the mtop freight API needs Alibaba request signing, which is not reproduced.
The edge serves a short x5sec interstitial to repeated automated access; the client retries a bounded number of times and fails closed without bypassing it.

account_policy.accounts: Shopping browser methods are assigned to the user-designated Assistant profile. The runtime remains disabled until its separate gate permits use.
account_policy.memberships: The operator's memberships on those sign-ins count when pricing, but only as the session shows them for the offer; never assume a membership the page does not show.
account_policy.read_only: Research only: never add to cart, check out, order, or change account settings.
account_policy.payment: Never add payment cards to any store account.
account_policy.privacy: Never record the operator's name, address, phone, order history, or account identifiers in logs, docs, or evidence; record only whether a session is signed in and which membership badges the page shows.
account_policy.profiles: Assistant is the shopping profile and the Google web-client profile (both protected and leased; Google web sessions are broker-mediated). Default is the non-personal agent profile for general, newsletter, and apk-acquisition work.
account_policy.context: Recipes may set a site's store or delivery ZIP; in Assistant this can change the operator's saved preferences, so check the current context first and change it only when it differs from the requested destination.
